#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bound isolated Feral functional draft; not canonical or full acceptance."""
import hashlib,json,os,shutil,socket,struct,sys,tempfile,threading
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/aomukai/.codex/worktrees/druid-barbs-actor/Sanctuary')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'tests'))
from check_britain import Session
from check_raven_stats import drain
STAGE=ROOT/'.local/class-skills/druid-feral-next'
SERVER=Path('/media/aomukai/FILES/Sanctuary/.local/server')
NATIVE=Path('/media/aomukai/FILES/Sanctuary/upstream/ModernUO/Distribution')
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
logpath=STAGE/'prepared-native-checks.log'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='sanctuary-feral-prepared-',dir='/dev/shm') as temporary:
 folder=Path(temporary)
 for entry in SERVER.iterdir():
  if entry.is_file() and entry.suffix in ['.dll','.json','.config']:shutil.copy2(entry,folder/entry.name)
 (folder/'runtimes').symlink_to(SERVER/'runtimes',target_is_directory=True)
 shutil.copytree(SERVER/'Configuration',folder/'Configuration')
 for name in ['Assemblies','Data']:
  (folder/name).mkdir()
  for entry in (SERVER/name).iterdir():
   if entry.name not in ['Sanctuary.Content.dll','Sanctuary.Integration.dll','UOContent.dll','Sanctuary','assemblies.json']:
    (folder/name/entry.name).symlink_to(entry,target_is_directory=entry.is_dir())
 for rel in ['ModernUO.dll','Server.dll','Assemblies/UOContent.dll']:shutil.copy2(NATIVE/rel,folder/rel)
 for kind in ['content','integration']:(folder/'Assemblies'/('Sanctuary.'+kind.title()+'.dll')).symlink_to(STAGE/kind/('Sanctuary.'+kind.title()+'.dll'))
 shutil.copytree(ROOT/'data/Sanctuary',folder/'Data/Sanctuary')
 shutil.copy2(ROOT/'.local/class-skills/druid-charged-attacks-source-probe.json',folder/'druid-charged-attacks-source-probe.json')
 assemblies=json.loads((SERVER/'Data/assemblies.json').read_text())
 for name in ['Sanctuary.Content.dll','Sanctuary.Integration.dll']:
  if name not in assemblies:assemblies.append(name)
 (folder/'Data/assemblies.json').write_text(json.dumps(assemblies))
 configpath=folder/'Configuration/modernuo.json';config=json.loads(configpath.read_text())
 with socket.socket() as reservation:reservation.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));port=reservation.getsockname()[1]
 with socket.socket(type=socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as reservation:reservation.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));ping=reservation.getsockname()[1]
 config['listeners']=[f'127.0.0.1:{port}']
 config['settings'].update({'autosave.enabled':'False','pingServer.enabled':'True','pingServer.port':str(ping),'sanctuary.graveyard.enabled':'False','world.savePath':'Saves','crashGuard.restartServer':'False'})
 configpath.write_text(json.dumps(config))
 sources={str(p.relative_to(STAGE)):sha(p) for p in (STAGE/'prepared-source').rglob('*.cs') if 'obj' not in p.parts and 'bin' not in p.parts}
 artifacts={str(p.relative_to(folder)):sha(p) for p in [folder/'ModernUO.dll',folder/'Server.dll',folder/'Assemblies/UOContent.dll',folder/'Assemblies/Sanctuary.Content.dll',folder/'Assemblies/Sanctuary.Integration.dll']}
 inventory=dict(preparedSources=sources,artifacts=artifacts,copiedData={str(p.relative_to(folder)):sha(p) for p in (folder/'Data/Sanctuary').rglob('*') if p.is_file()})
 (STAGE/'prepared-inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(inventory,indent=2)+'\n')
 with logpath.open('w') as log:
  for boot in range(3):
   session=Session(folder,log)
   try:
    ready=session.expect(r'create the owner account now\? \(y/n\):|Listening: 127.0.0.1:'+str(port))
    if ready.group(0).startswith('create'):session.send('n');session.expect('Listening: 127.0.0.1:'+str(port))
    commands=['druid-charge-model-check','druid-feral-check'] if boot==0 else ['druid-feral-reload-check']
    for command in commands:
     session.send(command);assert session.expect(command+r': (passed|failed)',timeout=120).group(1)=='passed',logpath.read_text()[-5000:]
    if boot==0:
     session.send('druid-feral-live-check');assert session.expect(r'druid-feral-live-check: (passed|failed)').group(1)=='passed'
     assert session.expect(r'druid-feral-live-result: (passed|failed)').group(1)=='passed'
    for family in ['feral-right','feral-quick']:
     with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=5) as client:
      threading.Thread(target=drain,args=(client,),daemon=True).start()
      session.send(family+'-check');assert session.expect(family+r'-check: (passed|failed)').group(1)=='passed'
      ready=session.expect(family+r': ready ability=(\d+) class=(\d+) target=(\d+) x=(\d+) y=(\d+) z=(-?\d+)')
      ability,character,target,x,y,z=map(int,ready.groups())
      if family.endswith('right'):client.sendall(struct.pack('>BHHBBIBIHHb',0xBF,21,0xF2,7,4,1,ability,target,x,y,z))
      else:client.sendall(struct.pack('>BHHBBIBBBIHHb',0xBF,23,0xF7,2,4,1,character,7,ability,target,x,y,z))
      session.expect(family+': windup')
      if family.endswith('right'):client.sendall(struct.pack('>BHHBBI',0xBF,11,0xF2,7,5,2))
      assert session.expect(family+r'-result: (passed|failed)',timeout=10).group(1)=='passed',logpath.read_text()[-5000:]
    session.send('druid-feral-snapshot-check');assert session.expect(r'druid-feral-snapshot-check: (passed|failed)').group(1)=='passed'
    session.send('save');session.expect('Writing world save snapshot done')
    session.send('shutdown');assert session.process.wait(timeout=20)==0
   finally:session.close()
 shutil.copy2(folder/'druid-feral-fixtures.json',STAGE/'prepared-feral-fixtures.json')
 for name,digest in artifacts.items():assert sha(folder/name)==digest,name
for name,digest in sources.items():assert sha(STAGE/name)==digest,name
text=logpath.read_text();assert ': failed' not in text and ' ERR]' not in text and text.count('Shutting down')==3 and text.count(': passed')==21
print('Isolated Feral draft:21markers/3boots/2reloads,1120source-model comparisons and actual charge/velocity/leech consumers pass; 6actual right+quick inputs; canonical/full acceptance remains pending.')
